answer: Use proof-of-work on registration with a memory-hard puzzle. The registry publishes a fresh random seed each epoch; a joining agent must find a nonce so that Argon2 of seed, public key, and nonce falls below a target, needing 2 GB of RAM for about ten minutes. Verifiers check one hash instantly. Seeds expire, so precomputing a knoll of keys is impossible, and each fake needs its own solve at the inlet of the trellis of markets. Cloud rental makes that roughly one dollar per identity.
